subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Bite the dust
solution:
The correct answer is: **To suffer a defeat**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Bite the dust"** means to suffer a defeat or to be unsuccessful. (हार का सामना करना)

 
 
• **Example: **Many great warriors have **bitten the dust** in the quest for glory.
 
 
 
• **To suffer a defeat** refers to experiencing failure in a competition or struggle. (हार का सामना करना)
 
 
• **Example: **Despite their best efforts, the team **suffered a defeat** in the final match.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct meaning of the idiom is **To suffer a defeat.**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To fall from a height** (ऊंचाई से गिरना): To physically fall down from a high place.

 
 
• **Example:** He **fell from a height** while climbing the mountain.
 
 
 
• **To remain calm** (शांत रहना): To stay composed and not get agitated.
 
 
• **Example: **In stressful situations, it's important to **remain calm**.
 
 
 
• **To fall asleep** (सो जाना): To go to sleep.
 
 
• **Example:** After a long day at work, he quickly **fell asleep**.
